_about: SRC-9 registry of connector gate coverage. One entry per connector type that connector_type lists as supported after all migrations (0035, 0043, 0062). 'gate' names the ops/ gate that covers the type today, or null. Each step (connect, discover, load, reload) is 'real' (the product does it and the gate must see it work), 'refused' (the product answers an honest supported:false today and the gate must see exactly that; the reason is the backlog item that will change it) or 'missing' (no gate asserts it yet). Read by the gates through ops/gates/gate_summary.py, which turns it and the results into the table in the CI job summary, and by the coverage check of SRC-9 task 8. Change it in the same commit as the gate or the product behaviour it describes. For change-capture types load is the first copy and reload is a later insert, update and delete arriving.
